dedupe_keys.name: portland oregon test data set arterial loop detector data

description: Portland, Oregon Test Data Set Arterial Loop Detector Data is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Automobiles", published or maintained by U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) --Recommended citation: "Portland State University. (2012). Oregon Test Data Set Arterial Loop Detector Data. [Dataset]. Provided by ITS DataHub through Data.transportation.gov. Accessed YYYY-MM-DD from http://doi.org/10.21949/1504484". This set of data files was acquired under USDOT FHWA cooperative agreement DTFH61-11-H-00025 as one of the four test data sets acquired by the USDOT Data Capture and Management program. This is the primary loop detector data table. It contains one-minute volume, occupancy, and data quality flags for the arterial loop detector data. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Automobiles". It has 11 columns, among them sampleperiod, status, timestamp, detectorid, dq_maxvol, dq_visual. The portal shows 2017-09-14 as the last data update. Attribution given: U.S. Department of Transportation Intelligent Transportation Systems Joint Program Office (JPO) --Recommended citation: . It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA-3.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
